subject: Update Makefile comments to relect name change (#106)
reason: The change only renames the TLS module build artifact in src/Makefile (redis-tls.so to valkey-tls.so, applied when BUILD_TLS=module). It is a build-system change with no runtime behaviour: no server code, command, replication, persistence or protocol path differs between the two builds, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or validate it.
